LanguageData.DefaultGameplaySettingsDesc: Set the default gameplay settings for new games.
LanguageData.RoyalFavorRewardDesc: Factions can reward you with Royal Favors.
LanguageData.GoodwillRewardDesc: Factions can reward you with Goodwill.
LanguageData.AutoExpandHomeAreaDesc: Home area will automatically expand around new constructions.
LanguageData.AutoRebuildDesc: Destroyed structures in the home area will be set to be rebuilt.
LanguageData.ShowZoneDesc: Display zones such as stockpiles, growzones.
LanguageData.ManualWorkPrioritiesDesc: Colonists will do priority 1 work from left to right, then priority 2 work from left to right, and so on.
LanguageData.DefaultMedicineSettingsDesc: Chose the default medical settings for each pawn categories.
LanguageData.DefaultProductionSettingsDesc: Set the default production settings for new production bills.
LanguageData.OutfitsDesc: Set default hitpoints for all outfits.
LanguageData.DropOnFloorDesc: Default bill policy to drop on floor instead of best stockpile.
LanguageData.SearchRadiusDesc: Sets the default search radius for new production bills.
LanguageData.ThreatResponseDesc: How colonists who join later react to a nearby threat.
LanguageData.NGP_PoliciesTabDesc: Policies stored here replace the default policies of every new game. Edit them directly, or capture the policies of the game you are currently playing. Reset a category to return to the unmodified game behavior.
LanguageData.NGP_ConfirmCaptureOverwrite: This will overwrite the currently stored set with the policies of the running game. Continue?
LanguageData.NGP_ConfirmResetPolicies: This will delete the stored policies. New games will use the unmodified game defaults. Continue?
LanguageData.NGP_ConfirmResetAreas: This will delete the stored areas. New games will not get any custom allowed areas. Continue?
LanguageData.NGP_CannotDeleteLastPolicy: Cannot delete the last stored policy. Use "Reset to vanilla" in the mod settings instead.
LanguageData.NGP_CannotDeleteDefaultPolicy: Cannot delete the default policy. Make another policy the default first.
LanguageData.NGP_StorytellerTabDesc: Pre-selects the storyteller page of every new game: storyteller, difficulty - including every custom difficulty setting - reload-anytime versus commitment mode, and the anomaly playstyle. You can still change any of it before starting, and nothing here touches a game already in progress.
LanguageData.NGP_StorytellerEnable: Pre-select these on the storyteller page
LanguageData.NGP_StorytellerEnableDesc: Off, the storyteller page behaves exactly as it does without this mod.
LanguageData.NGP_StorytellerNothingStored: Nothing is stored yet - every choice below is set to "leave unchosen", so the storyteller page will not change.
LanguageData.NGP_LeaveUnchosenDesc: The storyteller page asks for this as usual.
LanguageData.NGP_CustomDifficultyUnavailable: This version of RimWorld does not expose the custom difficulty panel, so it cannot be shown here. Named difficulties still work.
LanguageData.NGP_ConfirmCaptureStoryteller: This will overwrite the stored storyteller settings with those of the running game. Continue?
LanguageData.NGP_ConfirmResetStoryteller: This will clear the stored storyteller settings. The storyteller page of a new game will ask for everything as usual. Continue?
LanguageData.NGP_AreasTabDesc: These allowed areas are created (empty) on the starting map of every new game. Only names and colors carry over: painted cells belong to a specific map.
